title: Visit Plane’s Use Case Library, get more done with agents
summary: Plane's Use Case Library is a hub for AI workflows across HR, payroll, and benefits.
body_markdown:
“What can I do with AI agents to make life easier?”


Every week, we talk with HR pros who ask this question. They’ve got Claude or ChatGPT. Their to-do list is overflowing. They sense that many of their weekly tasks are repetitive, but where’s the best place to start automating?


Staring at a blinking cursor doesn't help much.


To make it easier, we’ve created the Plane[Use Case Library](https://plane.com/use-cases) , a catalog of step-by-step guides. Each one walks you through an agentic workflow, with detailed instructions on how to set it up.


Use one workflow to simplify everyday work. Or string together several, and make time for the strategic project you’ve been trying to get to.


[Visit the Use Case Library](https://plane.com/use-cases)


## A few ways to get started


At launch, we’ve filled the library with use cases that tackle some of the most time-consuming work in HR, from document creation to data analysis.


Here’s a preview of what you’ll find:


-


[Employment verification letters .](https://plane.com/use-cases/employment-verification-letter) See how an AI agent can pull HR data directly and draft an employment verification letter for anyone at your company.


-


[Payroll cost analysis .](https://plane.com/use-cases/payroll-cost-analysis) Use AI to analyze your payroll numbers by team or worker type. Ask it to track trends across multiple runs.


-


[Custom PTO dashboard .](https://plane.com/use-cases/visualize-time-off-data) Connect live PTO data, then generate a visual dashboard to spot unused vacation time and seasonal time-off trends.


## What’s next?


We’re just getting started. We’ll keep adding new use cases to the library, highlighting more ways to put AI agents to work.


And we’d love your thoughts. What’s a repetitive task you wish AI would take off your plate? Or a workflow you’ve been wanting to try, but aren’t sure how to build? The more HR busywork we can hand off to agents, the better. Let us know by submitting your use case below.
